cards.text_cn: 使前线 1 个友方单位撤退，将其完全修复。本回合此单位能再次行动。

cards.text_cn: 敌方部署单位时，失去剩余指挥点。
cards.text_en: When a unit is deployed, the enemy loses remaining kredits.

cards.text_cn: 若前线有友方日本单位，抽 2 张牌。

cards.text_cn: 抑制 1 个单位。若有友方空军，抽 1 张牌。

cards.text_en: Draw 5 cards. Your HQ takes 5 damage.

cards.text_cn: 对所有敌方单位造成 1 点伤害。若有单位被消灭，重复此效果。
cards.text_en: Deal 1 damage to each enemy unit. Repeat this effect if any unit is destroyed.

cards.text_cn: 完全修复 1 个受伤的友方单位。将 1 个复制加入支援阵线。
cards.text_en: Fully repair a friendly damaged unit. Add a copy of it to your support line.

cards.text_cn: 消灭敌方支援阵线 1 个单位。
cards.text_en: Destroy target enemy unit in the support line.

cards.text_cn: 部署：选择手中的 1 张花费不大于 3 的单位。将其加入战场。
cards.text_en: Deployment: Choose a unit in hand with a cost of 3 or less. Put it into play.

cards.text_cn: 双方抽数张牌，直到手牌数为 8。
cards.text_en: Both players draw until they have 8 cards in hand.

cards.text_cn: 将 1 个单位返回其所有者卡组顶。
cards.text_en: Put a unit on top of owner's deck.

cards.text_cn: 将卡组顶的 1 张苏联步兵加入支援阵线。
cards.text_en: Add the top Soviet infantry unit in your deck to your support line.

cards.text_cn: 将数个“轻步兵”加入支援阵线，直到已满，使其获得闪击。
cards.text_en: Add LIGHT INFANTRY to your support line until it is full. Give them Blitz.

cards.text_cn: 部署：若友方占领了前线，使 1 个敌方单位撤退。
cards.text_en: Deployment: If you control the frontline, target enemy unit must retreat.

cards.text_cn: 完全修复前线所有单位，使其获得 +1+2。
cards.text_en: Fully repair all units in the frontline and give them +1+2.

cards.text_cn: 亡计：若是敌方回合，随机将 1 个日本陆军加入支援阵线，使其获得此效果。
cards.text_en: Destruction: If it's the enemy turn, add a random Japanese ground unit to your support line and give it this ability.

cards.text_cn: 本单位受到的对战伤害至多为 1。
cards.text_en: Combat damage dealt to this unit is reduced to 1.

cards.text_cn: 选择并弃 1 张单位。使 1 个友方步兵或坦克获得其攻击力和防御力。
cards.text_en: Choose and discard a unit. Give its attack and defense to target friendly infantry or tank.

cards.text_cn: 若可能，将目标单位升为老兵，使其获得 +2+4。
cards.text_en: Target unit becomes Veteran if able, then gets +2+4.

cards.text_cn: 将双方手牌中花费最高的单位加入各自支援阵线。
cards.text_en: Both players add the unit with the highest cost in their hand to their support line.

cards.text_cn: 部署：压制 1 个敌方单位。友方回合开始时，再次将其压制。
cards.text_en: Deployment: Pin an enemy unit. At the start of your turn, pin that unit again.

cards.text_cn: 使所有友方非美国单位获得 +2+2。
cards.text_en: Give all your non USA units +2+2.

cards.name_cn: 因尼斯基林燧发枪兵团
cards.text_cn: 友方使用情报牌时，随机对 1 个敌方目标造成 3 点伤害。
cards.text_en: When you play a card with Intel, deal 3 damage to a random enemy.

cards.text_cn: 使卡组中所有英国单位获得 +2 防御力，使卡组中所有英国指令和反制获得 -1 花费。
cards.text_en: For each British card in your deck, give it +2 defense if a unit, otherwise reduce the cost by 1.

cards.text_cn: 单位攻击时，将其消灭。使所有友方单位获得 +1+1。
cards.text_en: When a unit attacks, destroy it. Your units get +1+1.

cards.text_cn: 部署：抉择：获得闪击并抽 1 张牌 或 获得守护并使友方总部获得 +4 防御力。
cards.text_en: Deployment: Choose One - Gain Blitz and draw a card OR gain Guard and your HQ gets +4 defense.

cards.text_cn: 消灭 1 个未受伤单位，随机排列所有敌方单位。
cards.text_en: Destroy target undamaged unit, then randomly rearrange enemy units on the battlefield.

cards.text_cn: 敌方使用指令时，对其总部造成 2 点伤害。
cards.text_en: When the enemy gives an order, deal 2 damage to the enemy HQ.

cards.text_cn: 对所有敌方单位造成 2 点伤害。若卡组顶是海军牌，改为造成 3 点伤害。
cards.text_en: Deal 2 damage to each enemy unit. Deal 3 instead if there is a Navy card on top of your deck.

cards.text_cn: 消灭 1 个单位，从卡组顶移除等同于其攻击力的卡牌。
cards.text_en: Destroy target unit. Remove cards from the top of your deck equal to its attack.

cards.text_cn: 对所有敌方单位造成 2 点伤害。
cards.text_en: Deal 2 damage to all enemy units.

cards.text_cn: 对所有敌方目标造成等同于友方空军数的伤害。
cards.text_en: Deal damage to each enemy equal to friendly air units.

cards.text_cn: 所有友方单位和总部获得 +3 防御力，抽 1 张牌。
cards.text_en: Give your units and HQ +3 defense and draw a card.

cards.text_cn: 额外获得 2 个指挥点槽。下个友方回合开始时，额外抽 1 张牌。
cards.text_en: Gain 2 extra kredit slots. Draw an additional card at the beginning of next turn.

cards.text_cn: 友方伏击单位造成的对战伤害翻倍。
cards.text_en: Your units with Ambush deal double combat damage.

cards.text_cn: 对敌方支援阵线所有单位造成等同于该阵线单位数的伤害。
cards.text_en: Deal 1 damage to each unit in the enemy support line for each unit there.

cards.text_cn: 部署：对 1 个敌方目标造成 2 点伤害。若是单位，将其压制。
cards.text_en: Deployment: Deal 2 damage to an enemy. If the enemy is a unit, pin it.

cards.text_cn: 部署：将 1 张“预备役”加入手牌。
cards.text_en: Deployment: Add RESERVES to your hand.

cards.text_cn: 本单位受到伤害或被完全修复时，获得 +2 攻击力。
cards.text_en: When this unit takes damage or is fully repaired, it gets +2 attack.

cards.text_cn: 部署：控制 1 个花费不大于 2 的敌方单位。
cards.text_en: Deployment: Take control of an enemy unit with cost 2 or less.

cards.text_cn: 本单位受到伤害时，使友方总部获得等量的防御力。
cards.text_en: When this unit is dealt damage, your HQ gets equal amount of defense.

cards.text_cn: 部署：从“北极护航队”、“燃烧的天空”和“铁锤”中开发 1 张。
cards.text_en: Deployment: Develop ARCTIC CONVOY, BURNING SKY or THE HAMMER.

cards.text_cn: 友方最左侧手牌具有 -2 花费，至少为 1。
cards.text_en: Your left-most card costs 2 less, to a minimum of 1.

cards.text_cn: 一回合一次，友方使用最左侧手牌时，抽 1 张牌。第三次后，升为老兵。
cards.text_en: Once per turn, draw a card when you play your left-most card. Becomes Veteran after the third time.

cards.text_cn: 将 1 个单位的复制加入友方支援阵线。三回合后，将其消灭。
cards.text_en: Add a copy of target unit to your support line. Destroy it in 3 turns.

cards.text_cn: 亡计：对敌方总部造成 2 点伤害。
cards.text_en: Destruction: Deal 2 damage to the enemy HQ.

cards.text_cn: 每个友方突击队随机对 1 个敌方目标造成等同于敌方明牌数的伤害。
cards.text_en: Each friendly Commando deals damage to a random enemy equal to known enemy cards.

cards.text_cn: 本单位攻击并消灭单位后，能再次行动。
cards.text_en: Can operate again after it attacks and destroys a unit.

cards.text_cn: 压制所有敌方单位，对其造成 1 点伤害。敌方失去 1 个指挥点槽。
cards.text_en: Deal 1 damage to all enemy units and pin them. Enemy loses a kredit slot.

cards.text_cn: 友方第一次额外获得指挥点槽时，抽 1 张牌。第二次时，使所有友方单位获得 +2+2。第三次时，升为老兵。
cards.text_en: Draw a card the first time you gain an extra kredit slot. Your units get +2+2 the second time. Becomes Veteran the third time.

cards.text_cn: 友方回合开始时，从“好人寥寥”、“胁迫”和“为了自由”中开发 1 张。
cards.text_en: At the start of your turn, Develop A FEW GOOD MEN, DURESS or FOR FREEDOM.

cards.name_cn: 牛津郡和白金汉郡轻步兵团
cards.text_cn: 部署：对 1 个敌方单位造成 2 点伤害。
cards.text_en: Deployment: Deal 2 damage to an enemy unit.

cards.text_en: Deployment: Add I-16 ISHAK on both sides of this unit.

cards.name_cn: 独立步兵第三百八十八大队

cards.text_en: Destruction: The enemy draws a card.

cards.text_en: Deployment: Destroy an enemy unit with two adjacent units.

cards.text_cn: 友方使用 1 张日本牌时，获得 +1+1，若攻击力不小于 10，获得守护。
cards.text_en: Gets +1+1 when you play a Japanese card, and Guard when attack is 10+.

cards.text_cn: 弃掉全部手牌。每弃 1 张，将 1 张“T-34 1942”加入手牌，使其行动花费为 1。
cards.text_en: Discard your hand. For each card discarded, add a T-34 1942 with 1 operation cost to hand.

cards.text_cn: 友方“爆破”造成的伤害 +1。\r\n友方“计划”抽取的卡牌数 +1。\r\n友方“生产”增加的指挥点数 +1。
cards.text_en: Your BLASTS deal +1 damage.\r\nYour PLANS draw +1 card.\r\nYour PRODUCTIONS give +1 kredit.

cards.text_cn: 消灭 1 个花费不大于 3 的单位，抽 1 张牌。
cards.text_en: Destroy target unit with cost 3 or less. Draw a card.

cards.text_cn: 友方单位对战并存活后，将 1 个“卫戍”加入支援阵线。
cards.text_en: When a friendly unit survives combat, add a GARRISON unit to your support line.

cards.text_cn: 将卡组顶的 1 张隐蔽单位和 1 个复制加入支援阵线。
cards.text_en: Add the top Covert unit of your deck to your support line. Duplicate it.

cards.text_cn: 若本回合使用过降雨牌，具有 -2 花费。随机消灭 1 个敌方单位。抽 1 张卡组顶的单位。
cards.text_en: Costs 2 less if Rain was played this turn. Destroy a random enemy unit. Draw the top unit of your deck.

cards.name_cn: 第 1 佛罗里达州步兵团
cards.text_cn: 亡计：随机使 1 个友方单位获得等同于本单位攻击力的攻击力与防御力。
cards.text_en: Destruction: A random friendly unit gets attack and defense equal to the attack of this unit.

cards.text_cn: 部署：对敌方总部造成等同于友方非法国单位数的伤害。
cards.text_en: Deployment: Deal damage to the enemy HQ equal to the number of non-French units you control.

cards.text_cn: 攻击力不小于 4 的友方陆军造成的伤害 +3。
cards.text_en: Your ground units with 4 or more attack deal +3 damage.

cards.text_cn: 部署：使 1 个友方步兵和手中及卡组中所有同名单位获得 +5+5。
cards.text_en: Deployment: Give a friendly infantry and all units with the same name in hand and deck +5+5.

cards.text_cn: 亡计：将 1 张“激怒”加入手牌。
cards.text_en: Destruction: Add an OUTRAGE to your hand.

cards.text_cn: 部署：每有 1 个敌方单位，获得一次 +1+1。
cards.text_en: Deployment: Gets +1+1 for each enemy unit.

cards.text_cn: 部署：前线每有 1 个单位，获得 1 个指挥点槽。使所有友方单位获得同等攻击力。
cards.text_en: Deployment: Gain 1 extra kredit slot for each unit in the frontline. Your units gain equal amount of attack.

cards.text_cn: 部署：将 1 个单位转换为“溃军”。若是友方，抽 2 张牌。
cards.text_en: Deployment: Convert target unit into ROUTED TROOPS. Draw 2 cards if it was friendly.

cards.text_cn: 单位被完全修复时，造成等同于修复数值的伤害，随机分配至所有敌方目标。
cards.text_en: When a unit is fully repaired, distribute the damage repaired between random enemies.

cards.text_cn: 敌方使用指令后，其随机弃 1 张牌。
cards.text_en: The enemy discards a card at random after giving an order.

cards.text_cn: 若本单位是唯一友方单位，具有 +4 攻击力。
cards.text_en: Has +4 attack if this is your only unit.

cards.text_cn: 友方被收缴单位消灭受到其伤害的单位。
cards.text_en: Your Salvaged units destroy any unit they damage.

cards.text_cn: 友方回合结束时，使相邻单位获得动员。
cards.text_en: At the end of your turn, give adjacent units Mobilize.

cards.text_cn: 部署：将 1 张“35(t) 坦克”和 1 张“协同作战”加入手牌。
cards.text_en: Deployment: Add a PANZER 35(t) and a COMBINED ARMS to your hand.

cards.text_cn: 友方使用指令后，随机对 1 个敌方目标造成 2 点伤害。
cards.text_en: After you give an order, deal 2 damage to a random enemy.

cards.text_cn: 部署：指向 1 个单位，使其移至前线。
cards.text_en: Deployment: Target unit moves into the frontline if possible.

cards.text_cn: 部署：将 1 个“游击队员”加入支援阵线，使友方“游击队员”获得 +3+3。
cards.text_en: Deployment: Add a SISSI to your support line, then give your SISSI units +3+3.

cards.text_cn: 部署：使 1 个单位的行动花费为 0。
cards.text_en: Deployment: Reduce the operation cost of target unit to 0.

cards.text_cn: 部署：从“闪电战”、“空中男爵”和“战术打击”中开发 1 张。
cards.text_en: Deployment: Develop BLITZKRIEG, SKY BARONS or TACTICAL STRIKE.

cards.text_cn: 友方步兵具有闪击。
cards.text_en: Your infantry have Blitz.

cards.text_cn: 友方总部防御力每大于敌方总部 1 点，使 1 个友方步兵获得一次 +1+1。
cards.text_en: Target friendly infantry unit gets +1+1 for every defense your HQ has over the enemy HQ.

cards.text_cn: 使所有友方单位的行动花费为 0。使友方总部获得等同于降低的行动花费总和的防御力。
cards.text_en: Set the operation cost of your units to 0. Gain HQ defense equal to total cost reduced.

cards.text_en: British air units you deploy get +2+2.

cards.text_en: Deal damage to target HQ equal to the total cost of your German tanks in the frontline.

cards.text_en: Draw 4 cards. Discard them at the end of your next turn.

cards.text_en: Deployment: Give your HQ +4 defense.

cards.text_cn: 对所有非老兵单位造成 4 点伤害。
cards.text_en: Deal 4 damage to each non-Veteran unit.

cards.text_cn: 友方手牌花费为 4。
cards.text_en: Cards in your hand cost 4 kredits.

cards.text_cn: 其他友方日本单位具有 +2 攻击力。
cards.text_en: Your other Japanese units have +2 attack.

cards.text_cn: 将 2 个“T-34 1942”加入支援阵线。
cards.text_en: Add two T-34 1942 to your support line.

cards.text_cn: 友方总部防御力不大于 10 时，花费为 4 。将“三式中战车”和“D3A2 九九舰爆”加入支援阵线。
cards.text_en: Costs 4 if your HQ is at 10 or less. Add TYPE 3 CHI-NU and AICHI D3A-2 to the support line.

cards.text_cn: 消灭 1 个单位。将 1 张此单位的复制加入手中。
cards.text_en: Destroy target unit. Add a copy of it to your hand.

cards.text_cn: 友方回合结束时，将 1 个“轻步兵”加入同一阵线。
cards.text_en: At the end of your turn, add a LIGHT INFANTRY to the same front.

cards.text_cn: 使前线所有敌方单位撤退，随机将 2 个攻击力之和为 6 的美国步兵加入前线。
cards.text_en: All enemy units in the frontline retreat. Add two US infantry units there with total attack of 6.

cards.text_cn: 消灭 1 个单位，从其所有者的手牌和卡组中移除所有复制。
cards.text_en: Destroy target unit. Remove copies of it from the owner's hand and deck.

cards.text_cn: 对所有敌方目标造成 2 点伤害。抽 2 张牌。额外获得 2 个指挥点槽。
cards.text_en: Deal 2 damage to all enemies. Draw 2 cards. Gain 2 extra kredit slots.

cards.text_cn: 部署：若有其他攻击力不小于 4 的友方单位，消灭 1 个敌方单位。
cards.text_en: Deployment: Destroy an enemy unit if you control another unit with 4 or more attack.

cards.text_cn: 友方回合开始时，若指挥点槽数不小于 13，升为老兵。
cards.text_en: Becomes Veteran at the start of your turn if you have 13 or more kredit slots.

cards.text_cn: 移至前线时，将 1 个本单位的复制加入相邻处。
cards.text_en: When 47th INFANTRY REGIMENT moves to the frontline, add a copy beside it.

cards.text_cn: 使所有友方英国单位获得 +2 防御力，使其攻击力等同于其防御力。
cards.text_en: Give your British units +2 defense, then their attack becomes equal to their defense.

cards.text_cn: 无法被敌方指令指向。
cards.text_en: Cannot be targeted by enemy orders.

cards.text_cn: 无法被压制。
cards.text_en: Cannot be pinned.

cards.text_cn: 亡计：将 1 个“IS-2”加入支援阵线。
cards.text_en: Destruction: Add a IOSEF STALIN II to your support line.

cards.text_cn: 抽 1 张步兵，坦克，炮兵和战斗机。
cards.text_en: Draw a random infantry, tank, artillery and fighter from your deck.

cards.text_cn: 随机消灭 2 个敌方单位。
cards.text_en: Destroy two random enemy units.

cards.text_cn: 部署：将 2 个具有闪击的“第 59 装甲掷弹兵团”加入支援阵线。
cards.text_en: Deployment: Add to your support line two 59. PANZERGRENADIER with Blitz.

cards.text_cn: 部署：消灭所有其他受伤的单位。
cards.text_en: Deployment: Destroy all other damaged units.

cards.name_cn: Ki-49 百式重爆 吞龙
cards.text_cn: 亡计：消灭所有单位。
cards.text_en: Destruction: Destroy all units.

cards.text_cn: 部署：消灭所有敌方空军。
cards.text_en: Deployment: Destroy all enemy air units.

cards.text_cn: 将所有敌方单位转换为“溃军”。
cards.text_en: All enemy units are Converted into ROUTED TROOPS.

cards.text_cn: 消灭 1 个敌方单位。抽取等同于其攻击力的卡牌。
cards.text_en: Destroy an enemy unit. Draw cards equal to its attack.

cards.text_cn: 使友方总部获得：“友方回合开始时，受到 1 点伤害，将 1 个‘T-34 1942’加入支援阵线。回合结束时，将其消灭。”
cards.text_en: Your HQ gets: \"At the start of your turn, take 1 damage and add a T-34 1942 to your support line. Destroy it at the end of the turn.\"

cards.text_cn: 敌方每有 1 张手牌，具有 -1 花费。对 1 个敌方目标造成 3 点伤害。
cards.text_en: Costs 1 less for each card in the enemy hand. Deal 3 damage to an enemy.

cards.text_cn: 完全修复友方支援阵线所有单位。消灭敌方支援阵线所有单位。
cards.text_en: Fully repair all units in your support line. Destroy all units in the enemy support line.

cards.text_cn: 每有 1 个攻击力不小于 4 的友方单位，对 1 个敌方目标造成 4 点伤害。
cards.text_en: Deal 4 damage to target enemy for each unit with 4 or more attack you control.

cards.text_cn: 钳击：友方回合结束时，完全修复本单位。
cards.text_en: Pincer: At the end of your turn, fully repair this unit.

cards.text_cn: 若在手中，敌方每抽 1 张牌，获得 -1 花费。
cards.text_en: If in your hand, reduce cost by 1 each time the enemy draws a card.

cards.text_cn: 抉择：将 1 张“7075 铝” 或 1 张“皇国二号兵器”加入手中。
cards.text_en: Choose One - Add 7075 ALUMINIUM to hand OR add IMPERIAL WEAPON No. 2 to hand.

cards.text_cn: 抉择：将 1 张“XXI 级 U 型潜艇” 或 1 张“铀工程”加入手牌。
cards.text_en: Choose one - add TYPE XXI U-BOAT to hand OR add URANPROJEKT to hand.

cards.text_cn: 抉择：将 1 张“主动声纳” 或 1 张“布莱切利庄园”加入手牌。
cards.text_en: Choose one - add ACTIVE SONAR to your hand OR add BLETCHLEY PARK to your hand.

cards.text_cn: 抉择：将 1 张“青霉素” 或 2 张“曼哈顿计划”加入手牌。
cards.text_en: Choose one - add PENICILLIN to hand OR add two MANHATTAN PROJECT to hand.

cards.text_cn: 抉择：将 1 张“倾斜装甲” 或 3 张“斯大林管风琴”加入手中。
cards.text_en: Choose One - Add SLOPED ARMOR to hand OR add three STALIN'S ORGAN to hand.

cards.text_cn: 无法被敌方指令指向。
cards.text_en: Cannot be targeted by enemy orders.

cards.text_cn: 使手中，卡组和场上所有友方日本单位获得：“亡计：对敌方总部造成 2 点伤害。”
cards.text_en: Your Japanese units everywhere get: \"Destruction: Deal 2 damage to the enemy HQ.\"

cards.text_cn: 本单位被返回手中时，将 1 个复制加入支援阵线。
cards.text_en: If sent to hand, add a copy to your support line.

cards.text_cn: 亡计：加入 2 个“步兵第 42 团”。使其中 1 个获得守护，另 1 个获得冲击。
cards.text_en: Destruction: Add two 42nd RIFLES. Give one Guard, the other Shock.

cards.text_cn: 对 1 个总部造成 8 点伤害。
cards.text_en: Deal 8 damage to target HQ.

cards.text_cn: 本单位在前线时，友方总部的防御力无法降为 1 以下。
cards.text_en: While in the frontline, your HQ cannot be reduced below 1 defense.

cards.text_cn: 部署：将所有敌方单位返回手牌。
cards.text_en: Deployment: Send all enemy units to hand.

cards.text_cn: 抽 4 张牌。若友方钳击单位数不小于 4，立即结束下个敌方回合。
cards.text_en: Draw 4 cards. If you have 4+ units with active Pincer, end the next enemy turn immediately.

cards.text_cn: 随机将总花费等同于指挥点槽数的 3 个美国单位加入支援阵线。
cards.text_en: Add 3 US units to your support line with total cost equal to your kredit slots.

cards.text_cn: 控制 1 个敌方单位。
cards.text_en: Take control of an enemy unit.

cards.text_cn: 直到回合结束，所有喷火花费为 0，使其部署时获得 +3+3。
cards.text_en: Until end of turn, Spitfires cost 0 to deploy and get +3+3 when deployed.

cards.text_cn: 将所有友方单位的攻击力和防御力翻倍。
cards.text_en: Double the attack and defense of your units.

cards.text_cn: 消灭所有单位。双方失去 6 个指挥点槽。使双方卡组中的单位获得 +3 攻击力。
cards.text_en: Destroy all units. Players lose 6 kredit slots. Units in decks get +3 attack.

cards.text_cn: 消灭所有单位。
cards.text_en: Destroy all units.

cards.text_cn: 部署：造成 6 点伤害，随机分配至所有敌方目标。
cards.text_en: Deployment: Distribute 6 damage randomly between enemies.

cards.text_cn: 将敌方手中和场上所有花费不大于 5 的卡牌返回其卡组顶。
cards.text_en: All enemy cards with cost 5 or less in hand and on the battlefield are put on top of enemy's deck.

cards.text_cn: 造成 3 点伤害。抽 3 张牌。额外获得 3 个指挥点槽。使所有友方单位获得 +3+3。
cards.text_en: Deal 3 damage. Draw 3 cards. Gain 3 extra kredit slots. Your units get +3+3.

cards.text_cn: 将 4 张“试制橘花”置于卡组顶。使其花费和行动花费为 0。
cards.text_en: Add four KIKKA on top of your deck. They cost 0 to deploy and operate.

cards.text_cn: 若友方总部防御力不小于 30，对 1 个总部造成 20 点伤害。抽 4 张牌。
cards.text_en: Deal 20 damage to target HQ if your HQ has 30 or more defense. Draw 4 cards.

cards.text_cn: 本单位部署或行动后，每有 1 个友方德国单位，获得 2 个指挥点。
cards.text_en: Gain 2 kredits for each of your German units after this unit is deployed or operated.

cards.text_cn: 消灭所有敌方单位。每消灭 1 个单位，获得 1 个指挥点。
cards.text_en: Destroy all enemy units. Gain 1 kredit for each unit destroyed.

cards.text_cn: 部署：消灭所有花费不大于 3 的单位。每有 1 个，对 1 个敌方目标造成 2 点伤害。
cards.text_en: Deployment: Destroy all units with cost 3 or less. Deal 2 damage to an enemy for each.
